svg.aria-label: Channel 04, inference: an AI briefing that pulls about 64 sources, ranks them, has Claude write the glue in three calls, and renders one static HTML file.
svg.text: one page. everything happening in AI.
Pulls ~64 sources, ranks and de-duplicates them, and has
Claude write only the glue — picking stories by list index,
so it can’t invent a link. Renders one static HTML file.
Thin days render thin. Nothing gets padded.
ZERO DEPENDENCIES · EVERY STORY LINKS OUT
